name: PS5 RetroArch
summary: Multi-system libretro frontend with RADV Vulkan rendering and a local WebUI.
description: A port of RetroArch to PS5 exposing many libretro cores (Dolphin, LRPS2, PPSSPP, Mupen64Plus-Next, Snes9x, mGBA, Genesis Plus GX and more). Illustrative example only.
author: mihawk-99

firmware.notes: Depends on an exploit chain and a HEN stack.

warnings: Requires your own BIOS/keys for some cores.
